chunks: 3978 - Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام entered the market of the date sellers, and there was a woman crying while disputing with a date seller. So he said to her, “What is the matter with you?”
She said, “O Amīr al-Muʾminīn, I bought dates from this man for one dirham, but its lower part turned out to be of poor quality and not like this which I had seen.”
So he said to him, “Return it to her.” But he refused, until he said it to him three times, and he still refused. Then he struck him with the whip until he returned it to her.
And he عليه السلام used to dislike that the dates be covered over.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful, the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.بِالدِّرَّةِ: with the whip or disciplinary staff
key_terms.بِدِرْهَمٍ: for one dirham, indicating the sale price
key_terms.تُخَاصِمُ: she was disputing or arguing a claim
key_terms.رَدِيًّا: poor in quality, defective or inferior
key_terms.رُدَّ عَلَيْهَا: return it to her, meaning restore her due
key_terms.سُوقَ التَّمَّارِينَ: the market of the date sellers
key_terms.يُجَلَّلَ التَّمْرُ: that the dates be covered over, concealing what lies beneath

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali عليه السلام do when a seller concealed defects in dates sold in the market?
ai.summary: This report narrates how Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام intervened in a market dispute when a woman was sold dates whose inferior quality had been concealed. It highlights the protection of buyers from deception and reflects his active enforcement of fairness in trade.
